newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Peregrine Euro CP program A1.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Peregrine Euro CP program A1.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had assigned an A-1 rating to Peregrine Investment Holdings Ltd's US$100 million multi-currency Euro-Commercial Paper Programme.

The rating reflected the irrevocable direct-pay, multi-currency letter of credit issued by Industrial Bank of Korea, rated A/A-1, as well as the programme's payment and legal structure, S&P said in a statement.
The rating agency said any short-term rating change on the Industrial Bank of Korea would translate into a corresponding rating change on Peregrine Investment's ECP notes.
